cases.label: Walk then turn
cases.text: A person walks forward, then turns around and walks back.

cases.label: Salute
cases.text: A person gives a crisp salute with the right hand, holds it briefly, then lowers the arm.

cases.label: Polite bow
cases.text: A person makes a polite bow and returns to standing upright.

cases.label: Disco step and full turn
cases.text: A person performs a disco dance, stepping side to side while alternating one arm overhead, then turns and finishes with both arms wide.
